title: Group OSCORE: epoch/key manager module
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-9mkj. New module in python/src/lichen: group key state = {group_id, key_epoch u32 (monotonic, wraps at 4294967295), current master_secret, previous epoch+key with rekey timestamp}. Validation: message epoch < current -> reject (rollback), epoch > current+1 unknown-future -> reject. Drives vectors key_epoch_increment, epoch_rollback_reject, epoch_future_reject.
